factors.detail: Covers.com projection 23.9 vs 17.5 line, +6.4 diff, 25.3% edge

analysis: This line has fully flipped since opening -- the Giants opened as 2.5-point home favorites and the market now has Arizona favored by 1.5 to 2.5, driven by a stacked set of Giants injuries: Jaxson Dart is out for the season (Wk2 knee) and Brian Burns, their best pass rusher, is now confirmed out for the year with a torn ACL. The model agrees directionally -- Elo now favors the Giants only marginally (4.4 net) before the injury hit, and the -5.5 injury adjustment flips that to a 1.1-point Cardinals edge after folding in Winston and Burns both being out.

The total is the cleaner angle here: both offenses rank bottom-5 in yards per play, both teams play run-heavy, clock-control football (top-5 in time of possession), and New York just lost its best pass-rush threat, which does not speed the game up. The model projects 40.8 adjusted points against a 44.5 market total, and Arizona is still finding some rhythm (Jeremiyah Love, Trey McBride) while New York is starting a backup QB with a new, unfamiliar backup (J.J. McCarthy) behind him. A clean, injury-driven under lean.
